documents.temporary-cache: A process cache reduces repeated work. It is cleared on application restart.
documents.checkpoint-store: PostgreSQL checkpoint store persists graph state. A worker process restart retains state in the checkpoint store.
documents.run-cursor: Elapsed seconds and completion status are stored in the run index for browsing.
documents.private-material: Project material with project scope is readable only by authorized project members. It is not available to guests.

cases.question: Which checkpoint store retains state after a worker process restart?
